memo.title: Plipkary Sprint 1 Kickoff
summary_points: Kickoff for Sprint 1 of the Plipkary project, focusing on core e-commerce flows.
Team roles and initial tasks were assigned for backend, frontend, infrastructure, and testing.
Vikram is handling backend APIs, Priya and Nithya are on the frontend, Arun is on payment integration, Suresh is on infrastructure, and Lakshmi is on testing.
A critical, non-negotiable investor demo is scheduled for April 15th, requiring the end-to-end flow of product listing, cart, and checkout to be functional.
Dependencies and blockers were identified, and team members were assigned to guide and unblock others.
A mid-sprint check-in meeting is scheduled for Thursday to review progress.
key_decisions: Vikram will prioritize the product listing API to unblock Priya.
Vikram will guide Arun on the Razorpay payment integration.
Priya will guide Nithya on the frontend payment redirect flow.
The staging environment must be stable by Friday to allow for weekend testing by Lakshmi.
The core flow (product listing, cart, checkout) must be ready for the investor demo on April 15th.
blockers: Priya is blocked on the product listing page pending the product API from Vikram.
Nithya is blocked on the cart UI pending the cart API from Vikram.
Suresh is blocked on deployment configuration pending environment variables from Vikram.
Lakshmi is blocked from starting test execution pending the APIs from Vikram and the staging URL from Suresh.
risks: Arun's lack of experience with payment APIs could introduce delays or bugs in the payment integration.
The tight deadline for the April 15th investor demo leaves little room for slippage in any area.
dependencies: Priya depends on Vikram for the product API.
Nithya depends on Vikram for the cart API.
Nithya depends on Priya for guidance on the payment redirect flow.
Arun depends on Vikram for guidance on payment integration.
Suresh depends on Vikram for backend environment variables.
Lakshmi depends on Vikram for the APIs and on Suresh for the staging URL.
next_steps: Vikram to send environment variables to Suresh by EOD today.
Vikram to push the product listing API by tomorrow evening.
Vikram to pair with Arun tomorrow on payment integration.
Vikram to complete all backend APIs by Wednesday.
Priya to help Nithya with the payment redirect flow this afternoon.
Suresh to share the staging URL with Lakshmi today.
Suresh to ensure the staging environment is stable by Friday.
Lakshmi to start test execution on Wednesday.
manager_actions: Schedule a mid-sprint check on Thursday to review progress.
highlights: The database schema for products, orders, and users is already complete.
The Cloud Run environment and CI/CD pipeline are set up, and the staging environment is live.

tasks.title: Develop REST APIs for cart management
tasks.description: Create and deploy the backend REST APIs for adding items to a cart, updating quantities, and viewing the cart. This is a blocker for the frontend cart UI development.
tasks.notes: Nithya is blocked on this for the cart UI and checkout page. This is part of the core flow for the investor demo.
tasks.escalation_details: Investor demo on April 15th is non-negotiable. This API is critical for the end-to-end flow.

tasks.title: Integrate Razorpay payment gateway
tasks.description: Implement the backend logic for payment gateway integration with Razorpay. This includes initiating payments and handling webhooks for payment confirmation.
tasks.notes: Arun has not worked with payment APIs before. Vikram will guide and pair with him, especially on webhook handling.
tasks.escalation_details: Investor demo on April 15th is non-negotiable. Checkout flow must be functional.

tasks.title: Deliver the product listing REST API
tasks.description: Prioritize and deliver the REST API endpoint for fetching the list of products. This is a critical blocker for the frontend product listing page.
tasks.notes: Priya is blocked on the frontend product listing page until this API is available.
tasks.escalation_details: This API is blocking frontend development for the investor demo on April 15th.

tasks.title: Build Homepage and Product Listing Page UI
tasks.description: Develop the frontend for the homepage and product listing page using Next.js and Tailwind. The product listing page will consume the API from Vikram.
tasks.notes: Depends on the product listing API from Vikram (Task t3).
tasks.escalation_details: Investor demo on April 15th is non-negotiable. Product listing is a core part of the demo.

tasks.title: Build Cart UI and Checkout Page
tasks.description: Develop the frontend for the shopping cart and the initial checkout page. This includes handling the payment redirect flow.
tasks.notes: Blocked on the cart API from Vikram (Task t1). Nithya is unsure about the payment redirect flow and Priya will guide her.
tasks.escalation_details: Investor demo on April 15th is non-negotiable. Cart and checkout are critical for the end-to-end flow.

tasks.title: Complete deployment config for staging
tasks.description: Finalize the Cloud Run deployment configuration for the staging environment. This includes adding the necessary backend environment variables.
tasks.notes: Blocked on receiving environment variables from Vikram (Task t7). Staging must be stable by Friday for weekend testing.
tasks.escalation_details: A stable staging environment is required for QA to test the full flow before the investor demo.

tasks.title: Provide backend environment variables to DevOps
tasks.description: Compile and send the list of all required environment variables for the backend service to Suresh.
tasks.notes: This is blocking Suresh from completing the staging deployment configuration (Task t6).
tasks.escalation_details: If not provided, staging deployment will be delayed, impacting testing timelines for the demo.

tasks.title: Prepare test cases for product and cart flows
tasks.description: Create a comprehensive set of test cases for the product listing page, cart functionality, and the basic checkout flow.
tasks.notes: Test execution will begin once APIs are deployed to staging. Needs the staging URL from Suresh (Task t9).
tasks.escalation_details: Test cases must be ready to ensure full test coverage can be executed before the demo.

tasks.title: Share staging environment URL
tasks.description: Share the URL for the newly created staging environment with the entire project team.
tasks.notes: Lakshmi needs this URL to prepare for test execution.
tasks.escalation_details: Delay will prevent QA and frontend developers from accessing the integrated environment.

tasks.title: Schedule mid-sprint review meeting
tasks.description: Schedule a meeting for Thursday to review sprint progress with all team members.
tasks.notes: The meeting is to be held on Thursday, April 10th, to check progress and address blockers before the final push for the demo.
tasks.escalation_details: If not scheduled, the team might miss a key checkpoint to align on progress for the demo.

meetings.title: Payment Gateway Integration Guidance
meetings.purpose: To guide Arun on Razorpay payment gateway integration and webhook handling.
meetings.agenda: Review Razorpay documentation; Discuss webhook handling; Pair on initial setup

meetings.title: Frontend Payment Redirect Flow Guidance
meetings.purpose: To guide Nithya on handling the payment redirect flow and checkout page on the frontend.
meetings.agenda: Review payment redirect logic; Discuss state management for checkout; Frontend implementation best practices

what_was_discussed: Kickoff for Sprint 1, focusing on the core e-commerce flow (product listing, cart, checkout) for a critical investor demo on April 15th, 2026.
Team roles and initial tasks were assigned across backend, frontend, infrastructure, and testing.
Key dependencies were identified, with most of the team blocked by backend API development.
A mid-sprint check-in meeting is scheduled for Thursday to review progress and address blockers.
what_was_decided: Vikram will prioritize the product listing API to unblock the frontend team.
Vikram will guide Arun on the Razorpay payment integration.
Priya will guide Nithya on the frontend payment redirect flow.
The staging environment must be stable by Friday, April 10th, to allow for weekend testing.
The core end-to-end flow is a non-negotiable deliverable for the April 15th demo.
what_to_follow_up: Confirm if Vikram has provided the environment variables to Suresh (was due EOD today, April 6th).
Check if Vikram is on track to deliver the product listing API by tomorrow, April 7th, to unblock Priya.
Verify that the pairing session between Vikram and Arun for payment integration is scheduled for tomorrow.
Ensure Priya has connected with Nithya to provide guidance on the payment redirect flow.
Confirm if Suresh has shared the staging URL with Lakshmi and the team.
open_questions: Given Vikram is a bottleneck for four team members, is his workload manageable to meet all critical deadlines this week?
What is the contingency plan if the payment integration is delayed due to Arun's inexperience?
How can we de-risk the timeline to ensure a stable end-to-end flow is ready for testing by Friday?
risks_to_watch: Centralized Dependency: Vikram is a single point of failure. His tasks block Priya, Nithya, Suresh, and Lakshmi. Any slip will cause a cascading delay across the entire project.
Tight Deadline: The April 15th investor demo leaves no room for error. The compressed timeline requires all dependencies to be resolved on schedule.

Testing Bottleneck: QA (Lakshmi) is blocked from starting end-to-end testing until all backend, frontend, and infrastructure tasks are complete, leaving a very small window for testing and bug fixing.
Inexperience Risk: Arun's lack of experience with payment APIs could introduce unforeseen bugs or delays in the critical checkout flow.
suggested_agenda: Status check on all of Vikram's tasks (Product API, Cart API, Env Vars).
Confirm Priya, Nithya, and Suresh are unblocked.
Progress report from Arun on the Razorpay integration.
Progress report from Priya and Nithya on frontend UI development.
Confirmation from Suresh on staging environment stability for Friday.
Review Lakshmi's test plan and confirm readiness for weekend testing.
Re-evaluate risks and timeline for the April 15th demo.
